subject: Core Mathematics
title: Probability I

outcomes.text: perform experiments involving probabilities in different situations,
identify the range of probability in different situations,
generate probability space of different events,
determine the probability of mutually exclusive and independent events,
apply the laws of probability in different situations,
determine the probability of independent events using tree diagrams,
appreciate the application of probability in real-life situations.

inquiry_questions: How is probability applied in real-life situations?
coreCompetencies:
Communication and collaboration: the learner carries out experiments such as tossing coins or throwing dice to illustrate experimental probability.
Citizenship: the learner acknowledges Kenyan currency as they carry out experiments of tossing coins.
Self-efficacy: the learner appreciates his/her ability to play games related to probability.
values:
Responsibility: the learner carefully tosses coins or throws dice to illustrate experimental probability.
Social justice: the learner plays games where they accept there is winning or losing and acknowledging honest outcomes.
pcis:
Social Cohesion: the learner interacts with others freely as they discuss, create and play games related to probability.
Life skills and values education: the learner uses different experimental events and lists down all the possible outcomes which assist in decision making.
Road safety: the learner discusses with peers the probability of getting pedestrians crossing the roads at undesignated areas and highlighting its dangers for public awareness.
transcription_policy: Source wording retained;line breaks/bullets normalised;source pixels authority.
notes: Outcomef says independent events;the suggested tree-diagram bullet also mentions mutually exclusive events. Teach disjoint terminal paths versus independent stages distinctly,not treat the concepts as synonyms.
Road-awareness case is fictional classroom reasoning without invented risk probabilities,road observation or unsafe crossing.
